title: Beer Steins
sub: Track which beer steins you have collected.
note: Every beer stein in the game.

Membership is read from the game's own BeerSteinsKeyword, so a new stein appears here on the next data update. Images resolve scoreboard/season art first, then seasonal-event art, then a placeholder — all reused, never copied.
